name: OpenConditions — Road & Traffic Conditions
description: Live road and traffic conditions as data (DATEX II / OpenLR / Open511 / WZDx) ingested into PostGIS and rendered as a map overlay, with Valhalla road-closure avoidance. Ships the ingestion service and the contributions API, serving the roads, fuel, parking, charging and cameras domains; OpenMapX reads them through its built-in OpenConditions integration and renders the overlay UI.
